newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Energy offers $200 mln notes due 2007.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Energy offers $200 mln notes due 2007.

text.p: Ocean Energy Inc said Thursday it intends to offer $200 million in senior subordinated notes due 2007.
The energy company also said it plans a tender offer to buy back the company's $125 million 13.5 percent senior notes due 2004.

Ocean Energy will offer the subordinate notes to qualified institutional buyers through an offering memorandum. It will use the proceeds of the offering to buy back the 13.5 percent senior notes and repay amounts outstanding on its revolving credit facility, the company said.
The offered notes have not been and will not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an applicable exemption for registration requirements, the company said.
